messages:
Rhea (sec-eng): Heads-up: scheduling a compact retest for the RBAC + KMS changes. Scope: produce full audit bundle for assessor with clear chain-of-custody. No prod touches.
Noah (infra): Envs: staging primary, tiny preprod canary for smoke.
Ibrahim (platform): We'll gate RBAC via feature flag and do a 5-min canary then widen. Terraform toggle in repo.
Jo (oncall): Window proposal: Wed 04:00-06:00 UTC. I'll be on the bridge. Rollback triggers: error rate >4% or median latency >1.5s on /infer.
Sasha (compliance): Evidence required: CloudTrail (AssumeRole, CreateServiceLinkedRole), KMS logs (Encrypt/Decrypt), STS token metadata, TLS proxy logs, and S3 bundle with manifest + checksums.sha256. Manifest must list exact queries and time ranges.
Noah (infra): Sample Logs Insights for KMS:
fields @timestamp, @message | filter @message like /Encrypt|Decrypt/ and @message like /alias/staging-temp/ | sort @timestamp desc | limit 200
Noah (infra): CloudTrail snippet:
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=AssumeRole --start-time 2026-06-10T03:50:00Z --end-time 2026-06-10T05:50:00Z
Ibrahim (platform): We'll tag ephemeral sessions with run=pen-5112233344 to make filters deterministic. Terraform snippet will be in the PR.
Jo (oncall): I'll run 100 synthetic requests and collect per-request token timings. If thresholds breached I'll flip flag and revoke sessions. Bridge link: https://call.redwood.ai/bridge/5112233344
ops-bot: scheduled-job created by Noah: rbac-kms-retest-5112 2026-06-10T04:10:00Z -> 2026-06-10T05:10:00Z (staging,preprod). JobID: sj-5112
Sasha (compliance): Upload path: s3://redwood-evidence/retests/5112233344/. Include manifest.json, checksums.sha256, explainer.txt. PGP-sign manifest if possible. I'll validate within 48 hours.
Rhea (sec-eng): Good. I'll publish pre-run checklist and add exact collection commands. Do not remove CloudTrail events for 30 days and do not rotate prod aliases. Tag JIRA SEC-9536 on the thread.
